specName: An opt-in mutation check marks weak requirements
request:
Issue #963: feat: show what is proven, tested, assumed or only claimed for each spec — slice 5 of 6, item r4 only. PR body must say `Part of #963` (r4), never Closes.

r4 · An optional mutation check after converge: break the code once per acceptance rule, scoped to the spec's files (Stryker for JS/TS, mutmut for Python), and mark a requirement whose tests never fail as "weak". Opt-in per project (decided 7 Nov), because it adds minutes. Acceptance: with the mutation check turned on, a requirement whose tests survive every planted bug shows as weak.

FR-001.title: The mutation check runs only when companion.yml sets mutation.enabled

FR-002.title: A Stryker report marks weak each requirement whose test files killed no mutant

FR-003.title: A mutmut summary records the caught count without marks

FR-004.title: Each read records Mutation check N of M caught and replaces earlier weak marks

FR-005.title: Coverage shows Weak between missing and tested and warns

FR-006.title: Implement runs the tool on the changed files when the setting is on

FR-007.title: Reading a report never fails the host; older records render as today

expectations: Running Stryker or mutmut from the extension itself
context: constraint: writers never fail the host; repository text renders as text
intent: An opt-in mutation check reads Stryker or mutmut reports, records the caught count, and marks requirements whose tests catch no planted bug as weak

decisions.decision: Read Stryker and mutmut reports rather than run the tools from the writer
decisions.why: The project owns its tool setup; the writer stays a never-fail recorder
decisions.rejected: Shelling out to stryker from write-context

decisions.decision: Weak only when the requirement test files ran against the mutants and caught none
decisions.why: Tests the report never ran prove nothing either way
decisions.rejected: Marking every requirement without a kill

decisions.decision: The check runs at the end of implement
decisions.why: Every flow runs implement; converge reads the result
decisions.rejected: A converge hook that step-by-step runs may not reach

decisions.decision: Weak is judged only from test files that faced a mutant (coveredBy or killedBy)
decisions.why: A test no planted bug reached proves nothing either way
decisions.rejected: Judging every test listed in the report

decisions.decision: A report that judges no requirement leaves earlier weak marks alone
decisions.why: A mutmut run or a partial Stryker run must not wipe evidence it cannot replace
decisions.rejected: Clearing all marks on every read

decisions.decision: Report keys match coverage refs by path suffix after normalising separators and the project root
decisions.why: Stryker keys are relative to where it ran, often a subpackage
